---
title: "Life Expectancy and GDP per Capita"
---

This page explores how life expectancy relates to GDP per capita, and how that relationship changes across time.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")

sample_years = [1997, 2007]

plt.figure()
for y in sample_years:
    sub = df[df["year"] == y]
    plt.scatter(sub["gdp_per_capita"], sub["life_expectancy"], label=str(y), alpha=0.7)

plt.xscale("log")
plt.xlabel("GDP per Capita (log scale)")
plt.ylabel("Life Expectancy")
plt.title("Life Expectancy vs GDP per Capita (selected years)")
plt.legend()
plt.show()
```

## Interactive Map (Life Expectancy, latest year)

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")
latest_year = df["year"].max()
sub = df[df["year"] == latest_year]

fig = px.choropleth(
    sub,
    locations="country",
    locationmode="country names",
    color="life_expectancy",
    hover_name="country",
    title=f"Life Expectancy by Country ({latest_year})"
)
fig.show()
```
